COLUMN.EXIT_ACTIONS: On Exit — run when a card leaves this column

COLUMN.TYPE_LOST_DESC: Cards that enter this column are automatically archived as Lost.

COLUMN.AUTO_ASSIGN_MAX_CARDS_HINT: When an agent reaches this number, the rotation skips them.
COLUMN.ACTIONS_EMPTY: No actions yet. Click + Add action to configure one.
COLUMN.ACTION_TYPE_WEBHOOK_DESC: POST or PUT JSON to a URL when this column is triggered.
COLUMN.ACTION_TYPE_SEND_MESSAGE_DESC: Send a Liquid-templated message to the card's conversation.
COLUMN.ACTION_TYPE_EXTERNAL_API_DESC: POST/GET/PUT request to a registered endpoint.

COLUMN.MESSAGE_SOURCE_INBOX_HINT: Used only when the card has no linked conversation.
